meta.subject: 修复 L2 cache 中 flush 时 tag 周期不对齐的问题

en.summary: Fixes the L2 directory flush path so the reported tag comes from the selected victim way in the response cycle, instead of from a misaligned delayed flush-tag register.
why_it_counts: The touched file is not a unit test despite its name; it defines the L2 directory data structures and datapath.
The patch directly changes flush response payload logic in the directory module.
The commit message explicitly says the flush tag timing was misaligned.
evidence: Directory_test.scala declares DirectoryEntry_lite, DirectoryResult_lite, and the directory response datapath, so it is DUT logic.
The flush result tag changes from RegNext(flush_tag, false.B) to ways(RegNext(flush_way, false.B)).tag.
The surrounding logic already delays flush set, source, dirty, and last_flush fields into the flush response, confirming this is the flush-response mux.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a set-associative cache or directory emits metadata for a flush or eviction, the returned victim tag must be taken from the way actually selected at the response point. If the design instead reuses a stale request tag or a pipeline register from the wrong cycle, flush responses can name the wrong line even though the chosen way and dirty status are otherwise correct.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A flush walker or invalidation path iterates over ways and returns victim metadata through a pipelined response interface.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drive the flush-response tag from a stale delayed tag register rather than reading the selected way tag at response time.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: use misaligned pipeline register for victim tag
portability_notes: This applies to directories, tag arrays, or cache controllers that pipeline flush metadata over multiple cycles.
The portable signature is a tag field that is delayed independently from the selected way index.
Use the architecture-level notion of victim tag emission; do not rely on the Ventus file name.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the flush or eviction response record that returns set, way, tag, and dirty metadata.
Locate the point where the selected way index is delayed into the response stage.
Replace the response-stage tag read from the selected way with an older tag register or a separately delayed request tag.
Keep the way, dirty, and valid timing unchanged so the fault specifically becomes a tag-cycle misalignment.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L2 directory flush response tag mux
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix changes flush-response tag generation to read the tag from ways(RegNext(flush_way)).tag instead of using the earlier RegNext(flush_tag) value.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Change io.result.bits.tag back to Mux(flush_issue_regnext, RegNext(flush_tag, false.B), read_bits_reg.tag).

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Flush or eviction responses can carry the wrong victim tag, which can cause incorrect writeback/invalidation targeting or mismatched higher-level coherence bookkeeping.
evidence_for_injection: The fix is a single-line change in the flush-response datapath, making the injected reverse edit easy to isolate.
The file contains the actual directory logic, not a separate testbench harness.
The changed expression ties the response tag directly to the delayed flush_way, which is the correct cycle-aligned source.
notes: The filename is misleading; this is still DUT logic and not test-only code.
This fault is portable to any set-associative directory or victim-selection pipeline.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L2 directory 的 flush 路径，使返回的 tag 来自响应周期真正选中的 victim way，而不是来自时序错位的延迟 flush_tag 寄存器。
why_it_counts: 虽然文件名像测试文件，但它实际上定义了 L2 directory 的数据结构和数据通路。
补丁直接修改了 directory 模块中的 flush 响应 payload 逻辑。
提交说明明确指出 flush 时的 tag 周期不对齐。
evidence: Directory_test.scala 中声明了 DirectoryEntry_lite、DirectoryResult_lite 以及 directory 响应数据通路，因此它是 DUT 逻辑。
flush 返回的 tag 从 RegNext(flush_tag, false.B) 改成了 ways(RegNext(flush_way, false.B)).tag。
周围代码已经把 flush 的 set、source、dirty 和 last_flush 等字段延迟到响应阶段，说明这里确实是 flush-response 的多路选择逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当组相联 cache 或 directory 在 flush/eviction 过程中输出 victim 元数据时，返回的 victim tag 必须来自响应点真正被选中的那个 way。如果设计错误地复用了陈旧的请求 tag，或者使用了来自错误周期的流水寄存器，那么即使选中的 way 和 dirty 状态是对的，flush 响应仍可能报告错误的 cache line。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: flush walker 或 invalidation 路径遍历各个 way，并通过带流水的响应接口返回 victim 元数据。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让 flush 响应的 tag 来自陈旧的延迟 tag 寄存器，而不是在响应时刻读取选中 way 的 tag。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 用时序错位的流水寄存器作为 victim tag 来源
portability_notes: 适用于 directory、tag array 或任何把 flush 元数据跨多个周期传递的 cache 控制器。
可移植特征是：tag 字段和选中 way 索引被独立延迟，导致两者不同拍。
应以“victim tag 输出”这一架构概念来映射，而不是依赖 Ventus 的文件名。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到 flush 或 eviction 响应中返回 set、way、tag、dirty 等信息的记录。
定位选中 way 索引被延迟到响应级的地方。
把响应级的 tag 读取替换成更早的 tag 寄存器，或一个单独延迟的请求 tag。
保持 way、dirty 和 valid 的时序不变，只重新引入 tag 周期错位。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: L2 directory 的 flush 响应 tag 选择逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 flush 响应中的 tag 生成改为从 ways(RegNext(flush_way)).tag 读取，而不是继续使用更早拍的 RegNext(flush_tag)。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 把 io.result.bits.tag 改回 Mux(flush_issue_regnext, RegNext(flush_tag, false.B), read_bits_reg.tag)。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: flush 或 eviction 响应会携带错误的 victim tag，从而导致写回/失效目标错误，或引发上层一致性账本失配。
evidence_for_injection: 修复是 flush-response 数据通路中的单行修改，因此逆向注入很容易隔离。
该文件承载的是真实 directory 逻辑，而不是独立 testbench。
修改后的表达式把响应 tag 直接绑定到延迟后的 flush_way，这正是正确的周期对齐来源。
notes: 文件名具有误导性，但它仍然属于 DUT 逻辑，不是 test-only 代码。
这种故障可以直接映射到任何组相联 directory 或 victim 选择流水。
